answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed identity with slashed collateral: each agent must lock tokens and a verifiable work history before transacting, so creating many fake identities means locking capital per identity. Like pigment marking a single ember in a nebula of copies, the stake makes every clone expensive to spawn and cheap to burn: if an agent misbehaves, its stake is slashed and its history blacklisted, so a sybil swarm bleeds funds faster than it can earn.
